title: Replay Telestrator — An idea becomes a connected system

scenes.title: Play, freeze, telestrate, release
scenes.purpose: Show an idea's signal move through a network once, freeze at the decision point, trace its route with telestrator marks and release to the consequence: the whole system lights up.
visuals: Dark navy grid 'footage' with blue-grey network nodes and edges
White IDEA node emitting a glowing signal along the edges
REPLAY tag with timecode (play / pause / resume states)
Yellow telestrator marks: origin ring, solid observed route, dashed decision ring, dashed inferred route with arrowhead, system ring
Red X striking the rejected branch

beats.development: REPLAY chrome and caption slide in; the signal leaves the IDEA node and travels the edges to the decision node, leaving a lit trail.
captions: An idea becomes a connected system

beats.development: Freeze: white frame flash, footage dims, timecode switches to pause. Telestrator circles IDEA, traces the observed path, rings the decision node, strikes the rejected branch with a red X and sketches a dashed NEXT route whose arrowhead appears only when the shaft arrives.
Release: playback resumes, the signal follows the sketched route into the system node, which blooms while its outbound edges and all nodes light up; SYSTEM ring and label settle by 2.65 s and hold.

findings: Brisk three-phase rhythm: ~1 s play, ~1 s telestration, ~0.6 s consequence with a short settled hold.
justifiedHolds: 2.65–3.00 s settled hold so caption and labels read cleanly.

notes: Single paused GSAP timeline at window.__timelines.video; signal position and trail derive from one proxy tween, recomputed on every seek.
